title: Xuzl
summary: Xuzl repeatedly summons animated swords to attack the raid.
overview: Xuzl repeatedly summons animated swords to attack the raid.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare repeated add pickup and avoid pulling Xuzl beyond his room.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Eight swords arrive after 45 seconds; further groups arrive every 30 seconds.
Each sword begins attacking a random member of Xuzl's hate list.
Crossing his southern room boundary returns him to bind and clears hate.
Swords are removed on victory or after 30 seconds out of combat.

notes: Approval E308. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
